what_this_is: the one remaining single-variable experiment of WP420-05: the r3 reward table and the KL anchor at 200,000 frames instead of 50,000, everything else copied value-for-value; measured with the same frozen evaluator and the same 20 dev seeds as every other arm

declaration.declaration: this experiment changes exactly one variable: pilot.frame_budget 50000 -> 200000. It adds no second factor: the reward table, the KL anchor (beta 1.0, T=1, gate_mode diagnostic_only), every PPO coefficient, the rollout length, the temperature, the discount and the train seeds are byte-identical to rl-engine-r3-pilot.json. The only other differences are output naming and the private cp -a data dir.

the_one_changed_variable.everything_else: copied value-for-value from the frozen 50k config; the unit test asserts the diff is this key plus output naming

reference_measurements.note: measured before this run and only quoted here; they are the fixed comparison the prediction is stated in

prediction.text: the 200k checkpoint reaches R0 on BOTH dev rulers: diag_first_death mean >= 1636.8 frames AND s1n mean >= 3011.5 frames, each n=20 over dev seeds 1000-1019
prediction.note: the same two thresholds the r3 50k prediction used (REWARD_R3.md 5 / 8.4), so 50k -> 200k is measured on the same instrument

decision_rule.if_both_legs_hold: the 49-update budget, not the reward visibility, was the binding constraint: the r3 ordering signal converts into frames once the budget is 4x, and 200k -> 1M needs its own budget
decision_rule.if_either_leg_fails: reward visibility is NOT the main cause of the remaining gap to R0: the 200k checkpoint still does not reach the untrained-but-anchored reference, so the next question is the policy side (advantage normalisation, rollout length) or the reward table, each needing its own pre-registration before its own run
decision_rule.no_tuning: no epsilon / delta / beta / lr / temperature / gamma / reward table / rollout length is changed in response to any number in this experiment, whatever the verdict

expected_cost.note: arithmetic only, from the r3 50k run at 49.39 fps under load 4.4-7.1; NOT a result and not a schedule promise

pre_registered_budget_curve.what: 50k -> 200k diag/s1n change, gap closed against the R2 -> R0 gap, and marginal frames per +10,000 frames

config.diff: only pilot.frame_budget (50000 -> 200000), output naming and the private data dir; tests/test_v420_rl.py asserts it leaf by leaf

gate.note: recorded for diagnosis; the run is not failed by this bound (see criterion_revision)

run.declaration: R2 uses engine-truth reward and termination, so it is a training-time privileged diagnostic: it is NOT strict pixel self-improvement (R1) and no result here may be reported as R1.

prediction.rule: diag_first_death mean >= 1636.8 AND s1n mean >= 3011.5, n=20 each
prediction.reading: reward visibility is NOT the main cause of the remaining gap to R0: the 200k checkpoint still does not reach the untrained-but-anchored reference, so the next question is the policy side (advantage normalisation, rollout length) or the reward table, each needing its own pre-registration before its own run

R0.what: the untrained anchored A0 checkpoint (T04, frozen)

R2_no_anchor.what: the 50k r2 run without the KL anchor

R2_plus_KL.what: the 50k r2 run with the KL anchor

R3_50k.what: the 50k r3 run with the KL anchor

R3B200.what: the 200k r3 run with the KL anchor (this tier)
